skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts related to national income, consumer price index, inflation, unemployment, financial system, and monetary system.
Apply simple models to explain short-term economic fluctuations and the role of macroeconomic policies in stabilizing the economy.
Develop argumentation skills to analyze and solve basic macroeconomic problems.
Improve research skills, work independently and in groups, develop discussion, critical thinking, and creative problem-solving skills.
Enhance self-learning and research skills to deepen understanding of macroeconomic issues.
